agents.task: Read the test specification at {{FIXTURE_DIR}}/docs.md in full, then read {{FIXTURE_DIR}}/src/lib.rs to see the exact implementation of parse_duration. Write the required unit-test suite to /tmp/generated-tests.rs with the Write tool, following the coverage matrix and the quality requirements in the specification. Then change into {{FIXTURE_DIR}} and run `make check` with the Bash tool, which compiles your file against src/lib.rs and runs the resulting test binary. If any check reports FAIL, read the diagnostics, fix /tmp/generated-tests.rs and re-run `make check` until it prints RESULT: PASS. Do not modify any file inside the workspace; /tmp/generated-tests.rs is the only artifact you write. Report the final RESULT line, the number of tests that passed, and the output of `rustc --version`.
